name: Opportunity ledger

directionContract.thesis: A work-opportunity ledger that refuses the generic marketplace card stack.
directionContract.ownWorld: Trust Blue calm utility with slate text, quiet surfaces, docket rows, and blue reserved for action, active place, and live status.
directionContract.story: A cleaner sees applied work first, knows it is not an assignment, compares open jobs by time, duration, and pay, then applies once.
directionContract.firstViewport: Compact brand header, cleaner identity, edge-to-edge applied band, open count, metric-first work docket, and labelled icon navigation.
directionContract.form: Opportunity ledger, structure 3 of the approved board comparison, seed the-clean-crew-trust-blue-v1.
directionContract.finish: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, and DESIGN.md

prompt: A high-fidelity mobile PWA composition probe for The Clean Crew board using the established Trust Blue system. Composition: branded header; slim full-width applied-status band; visible Open jobs count; dense work-docket cards pairing date, time, duration and pay before company/site/service details and Apply for job; fixed labelled bottom navigation. Only real demo facts, no invented features or private job details.
